title: 10/2/2026 | Nate Sheets | LTRS | Nate Sheets Letter in Opposition to the 765kV Lines

documents.text:
=== NS 765.pdf ===
Dear Commissioners:

I write to express my opposition to the proposed 765-kV transmission buildout in its current
form.

Texas is growing, and we need reliable power and infrastructure to support that growth. But
projects of this magnitude must make sound economic sense, protect private property rights,
and justify the costs Texans will be asked to bear. I do not believe the proposed buildout meets
that standard.

I urge the Commission to reconsider this approach before allowing these projects to move
forward. Texas should prioritize reliable, dispatchable generation and carefully evaluate
alternatives that could meet our energy needs with less disruption to farms, ranches, and rural
communities and lower costs to ratepayers. Affected landowners deserve meaningful input
throughout that process.

We need infrastructure—but we need to build it the Texas way, with respect for private property
and accountability to the families paying the bill.

Respectfully,

Nate Sheets​
Candidate for Texas Agriculture Commissioner
